subject: QBR prep: consolidated forecast + account playbook asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR prep: consolidated forecast + account playbook asks

Team,

We need to lock the QBR packet for execs by Monday, Nov 29. Two asks to get me and the leadership team comfortable with the numbers and customer narratives:

1) Consolidated forecast sheet: please drop your most recent committed and best-case numbers into the attached forecast_template.xlsx. I want a single tab per AE with clear EOY ARR, close probability, and expected billing quarter.

2) Account playbooks: for the top 10–12 runway accounts (by ARR and likelihood to close before EOY) prepare a one-page brief that includes: current status, blockers, primary stakeholders, required procurement or security docs, and the recommended close motion (e.g., contract + pilot, PO + SOW, channel). Attach to the thread or save under the shared Drive folder.

Deadline: EOD Wed, Nov 25. If you cannot meet this, flag now so we can reassign.

Notes: I expect specialty procurements (Nimbus Health) to include SOC2 evidence and our dedicated deployment notes—Monica, please coordinate with the security checklist. Marissa, ensure sales ops aligns the numbers with HubSpot deal stages so we don't double-count pipeline.

Attachments: forecast_template.xlsx (blank tab per AE)

—
Markus Klein
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: consolidated forecast + account playbook asks

Thanks Markus — noted. Quick clarifications:

- Cutoff: do you want the snapshot to reflect committed numbers as of close-of-business on Nov 25 or Nov 26? Our field team is in customer meetings next week and needs the final cutoff to avoid churn in numbers.
- Nimbus Health: I’ll start the brief but will need Monica to attach the SOC2 packet and procurement cadence.

I’ll populate my team tab by Tue EOD and circulate a roll-up for review.

Markus / team,

Attached is a first pass — I filled the Nimbus Health row and attached the quick one-page I drafted from last week’s calls. Highlights below:

- Nimbus Health: $1.1M ARR potential, close probability 60% (legal waiting on a standard BA and SOC2 artifact; procurement wants to run a week-long security review).
- Recommended motion: Dedicated trial (1 month) + PO to convert; negotiate payment terms in SOW.

Attachments: account_brief_nimbus.pdf (stub - internal draft)

I’ve CC’d Jen (Cloudstream) since she’s the internal champion and can confirm timing. Jen — can you confirm whether Nimbus will be able to complete the procurement review before Dec 15 or if they’ll need an extended timeline?

Hi Rishi / Markus,

Thanks for the snapshot — quick note from Nimbus: procurement has a scheduled window the week of Dec 6 for vendor security assessments. They’re unlikely to finish a full review before Dec 15. Our CISO has asked for the latest contract redline (we made a few edits in clause 7 and 12) so we can validate legal language; can you point me to the current redline?

If we can get the trial scoped and a PO in advance of legal sign-off, that’s still a meaningful motion for Q4 from our side.

Appreciate the fast turnaround everyone — consolidation plan below and explicit owners: 

- Forecast numbers: Marissa to lock HubSpot staging and merge tabs into the consolidated spreadsheet. Owner: Marissa Cole. Due: Nov 25 COB. (Attachment: forecast_template.xlsx)
- Nimbus Health playbook: Rishi to finalize 1-pager; Monica to append SOC2 + procurement artifacts; Jen to provide procurement timeline and signal. Owners: Rishi / Monica / Jen. Due: Nov 25 COB (draft), final by Nov 30. (Attachment: account_brief_nimbus.pdf)
- Contract redline: Marissa, please surface the latest vendor redline in Drive and link here so the Nimbus legal team can review. Suggest we attach contract_redline_v2.docx.

If anything shifts with the cutoff dates, call it out by EOD Sunday so I can reshuffle reviewers. I’ll produce the executive roll-up on Nov 26 morning.

Thanks — keep the updates inline so I can track changes.

—
Markus Klein
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
